title: Zebedee’s mother asks for right and left seats
english: On the request of the mother of Zebedee’s sons. The mother of the sons whom the Savior named [[Boanerges >> Bible:Mark 3:17]] asked that one sit [[on his right and one on his left in his kingdom >> Bible:Matthew 20:21]]. To those who cannot search depths the petition looks simple; to deeper hearers Jesus’ answer also shows greatness. As in worldly kingship those seated with the king are honored, so the two apostles — still imperfect about Christ’s kingdom — supposed. But Jesus says: [[You do not know what you are asking >> Bible:Matthew 20:22]] and [[it is not mine to give, but for those for whom it has been prepared by my Father >> Bible:Matthew 20:23]].

title: What sitting at right and left means in Scripture
english: Ask what sitting at Jesus’ right or left in the kingdom means. Gather the seats of God or Christ written elsewhere: Micaiah saw the Lord [[seated on his throne >> Bible:1 Kings 22:19]]; Isaiah [[saw the Lord seated on a high throne >> Bible:Isaiah 6:1]]; Daniel until [[thrones were set and the Ancient of Days sat >> Bible:Daniel 7:9]]; the Psalm [[Sit at my right hand >> Bible:Psalm 110:1]]; and the Gospels when [[the Son of Man sits on the throne of his glory >> Bible:Matthew 19:28]]. Perhaps the right are the intelligible unseen works, the left the visible and bodily — yet Christ reigns over all. Glory to Christ. Amen.
